title: Pure Glacial Beast
summary: Pure Glacial Beast and Penguin Synchro control build, pairing the Arctic Aqua beasts with classic Penguin recursion and WATER staples. By utilizing The Great Emperor Penguin and Royal Penguins Garden, the deck repeatedly triggers Glacial Beast Polar Penguin's bounce effects, protects the board with Blizzard Wolf, and dominates the Battle Phase through Glacial Beast Iceberg Narwhal.

summary.title: Starters & Searchers
points: The Great Emperor Penguin tributes itself to Special Summon up to two Penguin monsters (such as Glacial Beast Polar Penguin and Nopenguin) directly from your Deck.
Royal Penguins Garden adds any Penguin card (including Glacial Beast Polar Penguin) from your Deck to your hand upon activation, then discards a card to reduce a Penguin's Level by 1.
Swap Frog Special Summons itself by discarding a WATER monster, milling Glacial Beast Blizzard Wolf, Nopenguin, or Emperor Penguin to set up revives.
Foolish Burial dumps Nopenguin or Blizzard Wolf directly from the Deck to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Royal Penguins Garden + The Great Emperor Penguin
steps: Activate Royal Penguins Garden to search Glacial Beast Polar Penguin (or Nopenguin) from your Deck to your hand.
Use Royal Penguins Garden's second effect to reveal The Great Emperor Penguin, reduce its Level by 1, and discard 1 card from your hand.
Normal Summon The Great Emperor Penguin with 1 Tribute (or via Level reduction) and tribute it to Special Summon Glacial Beast Polar Penguin and Nopenguin from your Deck.
Glacial Beast Polar Penguin triggers on Special Summon to return an opponent's monster to the hand; Nopenguin in GY revives itself and changes the bounce to banishment.
Synchro Summon Glacial Beast Iceberg Narwhal (Level 7) using Level 3 Tuner Polar Penguin and Level 4 (or Level 3 Nopenguin plus extra Level) or summon Penguin Brave (Level 6).

summary.title: Graveyard Recursion & Banishment
points: Glacial Beast Polar Penguin bounces an opponent's monster whenever it is Special Summoned, or bounces any card on the field if destroyed by battle or card effect.
Nopenguin turns every card returned to the hand by a Penguin card (including Polar Penguin) into non-target banishment instead, and revives itself whenever a Penguin effect activates.

Glacial Beast Blizzard Wolf revives itself from the GY at the start of the opponent's Battle Phase if you control no monsters, and negates an attack once per turn to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower WATER monster (like Polar Penguin) from your hand.
Surface and Marincess Coral Anemone revive Polar Penguin directly from the GY, immediately triggering its monster removal effect.

summary.title: Bosses & Battle Control
points: Glacial Beast Iceberg Narwhal (Level 7 Synchro) burns the opponent for 600 damage whenever your monster is destroyed, and during the Battle Phase while you control another monster, negates the activation of any opponent card or effect and destroys it.
Penguin Brave (Level 6 Synchro) sets a Penguin monster from your Deck upon Synchro Summon and flips it face-up as a Quick Effect when the opponent activates a monster effect.
White Aura Whale wipes all opponent Attack Position monsters on Synchro Summon, attacks twice on monsters, inflicts piercing damage, and revives itself as a Tuner.
Adamancipator Risen - Dragite and Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying offer high-Level Synchro board disruption and protection.

allow.Swap Frog: Level 2 WATER Aqua that sends Glacial Beast Blizzard Wolf or The Great Emperor Penguin from the Deck to the GY on Summon.
allow.Surface: Spell that revives Level 3 Glacial Beast Polar Penguin from the GY in Defense Position—immediately triggering Polar Penguin's on-Special-Summon effect to return 1 monster your opponent controls to the hand!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Glacial Beast Blizzard Wolf or Nopenguin to the GY.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Link-2 WATER monster that revives Glacial Beast Polar Penguin or Blizzard Wolf (both have 1500 or less ATK!) from the GY—triggering Polar Penguin's monster bounce!
allow.White Aura Whale: Level 8 WATER Synchro companion that destroys all opponent's Attack Position monsters on Synchro Summon.
allow.Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying: Level 10 WATER Synchro boss accessible via Polar Penguin + Level 7 Iceberg Narwhal or Ran Aegirine.

main: Glacial Beast Polar Penguin

Level 3 WATER Aqua Tuner: targets 1 monster the opponent controls and returns it to the hand when Special Summoned (or returns 1 card on field if destroyed by battle/effect); treated as both a 'Glacial Beast' and 'Penguin' monster!
Glacial Beast Blizzard Wolf

Level 4 WATER Aqua non-Tuner: negates an attack once per turn to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower WATER monster (Polar Penguin!) from your hand, and revives itself from the GY at the start of the opponent's Battle Phase if you control no monsters.
Penguin Squire
Level 5 WATER Aqua Tuner that Special Summons itself when a monster is Set and reduces its Level by 1 or 2 to Synchro Summon Level 7 Glacial Beast Iceberg Narwhal.
The Great Emperor Penguin

Tributes itself to Special Summon up to 2 'Penguin' monsters (Glacial Beast Polar Penguin + Puny Penguin/Nopenguin) directly from your Deck—immediately triggering Polar Penguin's bounce effect and assembling a Synchro Summon!
Nopenguin
Level 3 WATER Aqua that revives itself from the GY whenever a Penguin effect (including Glacial Beast Polar Penguin!) is activated, and changes Polar Penguin's 'return to hand' effect into 'banish'!
Puny Penguin
Revives a Penguin monster (Glacial Beast Polar Penguin!) from the GY in face-up Attack or face-down Defense Position when sent to the GY after being flipped.
Penguin Ninja
Level 3 WATER Aqua that bounces up to 2 opponent's Spells/Traps when flipped and flips Penguins face-down.
Swap Frog
Special Summons itself by discarding a WATER monster and sends Glacial Beast Blizzard Wolf or Nopenguin from the Deck to the GY on Summon.
Royal Penguins Garden

Continuous Spell that searches ANY 'Penguin' card (including Glacial Beast Polar Penguin!) on activation, then reduces a Penguin's Level by 1 and discards 1 card (putting Blizzard Wolf or Nopenguin into the GY).
Surface
Special Summons Level 3 Glacial Beast Polar Penguin from your GY in Defense Position, immediately triggering Polar Penguin's effect to bounce (or banish via Nopenguin!) an opponent's monster.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Nopenguin or Glacial Beast Blizzard Wolf to the GY.
extra: Signature Level 7 WATER Aqua Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner WATER monsters): inflicts 600 burn damage whenever your monster is destroyed by battle/opponent's effect, and during the Battle Phase while you control another monster, negates and destroys ANY card or effect your opponent activates!

Level 6 WATER Aqua Synchro (summoned with Level 3 Polar Penguin + Level 3 Nopenguin) that Special Summons a Penguin from the Deck face-down and flips it face-up when the opponent activates a monster effect.
Link-2 WATER monster that revives Glacial Beast Polar Penguin (800 ATK) or Blizzard Wolf (1400 ATK) from the GY, triggering Polar Penguin's on-Special-Summon bounce!
Level 8 WATER Synchro that wipes the opponent's Attack Position monsters.
Level 8 Synchro: excavates top 5 cards to bounce opponent's cards, and Quick Effect negates Spells/Traps while a WATER monster is in GY.
Level 10 Synchro: gains ATK/DEF from banished cards, protects itself from destruction, and banishes 1 card each from field and GY.
